content: Dark/light theming for glassmorphism: CSS custom property tokens (--glass-bg, --glass-border, --glass-blur, --text-strong). data-theme attribute or prefers-color-scheme. Light: rgba(255,255,255,0.15), blur(16px), border 0.2. Dark: rgba(255,255,255,0.06), blur(12px) brightness(1.1), border 0.08. prefers-contrast:more gives near-solid backgrounds. Saturation boost: saturate(180%) for vibrant glass. Elevation levels (glass-elev-1...3). Match glass tint to background tone. @supports fallback for older browsers. 95%+ backdrop-filter support in 2026.
